spans.text: For this activity, the table will be created in a spreadsheet. Like spreadsheets, databases also store data in rows and columns, which means the data is represented in a similar way.
Type the Field Names in the spreadsheet as seen below.
Club Code | Club Name | Registration Date | Number of members

Set the data type of each field (column). Select the range of cells (e.g. A2:A6). Use the Data Validation feature to set the data type. Repeat this action for the other fields (Club Name, Registration Date, Number of members).
Data Validation was covered in Stage 5.
Enter the data. There are five clubs which means there will be five records. Each record will contain data in the fields related to the respective club.
The first record contains data on the Book club: club code BO101, registration date is 14/9/2022 and number of members is 15.
